title: Mountain Retreat
description: Perched above the central mountain range with panoramic views of the rainforest canopy, this retreat required treatments that preserved sightlines while managing intense morning light. Light-filtering roller shades in a natural woven texture were selected to soften glare without obscuring the landscape. The result is a seamless boundary between interior and exterior — the fabric becomes part of the view.
